title: Present Perfect Continuous (I have been doing)
en:
have / has been + -ing — an activity that started in the past and is still going on (or just stopped), often with for, since, how long: I've been working here for six years. How long have you been learning English?

Also for a recent activity with a visible result: You look tired. — I've been preparing for the audit all day.

Continuous = the activity, how long. Simple = the result, how many: I've been writing reports all morning. I've written three reports.

State verbs (know, like, have = own) stay simple: I've known him for years.
ru: have/has been + -ing — действие началось в прошлом и продолжается до сих пор (for, since, how long): I've been working here for six years. Continuous — процесс, как долго; Simple — результат, сколько. Глаголы состояния (know, like) — только Simple: I've known him for years.

boss.situation: Talk about your job and your English: 3 sentences with have been + -ing (how long) and 2 with the Present Perfect Simple (results).
samples: I've been working in internal control for six years.
I've been learning English with Ainura since September.
Recently I've been preparing for an audit.
I've already tested twelve controls this month.
I've known my manager for a long time.

qs.exp: Since + still continues → Present Perfect Continuous.
qs.ru: С 2019 и до сих пор — have been working.

qs.exp: How long + still going → have you been.
know is a state verb → simple.

qs.q: You look tired. — I ___ all day.
qs.exp: Recent activity with a visible result → continuous.

qs.q: “I've been writing three reports today” is the best choice.
qs.exp: Number of results → simple: I've written three reports.

qs.q: “She has been waiting for an hour” means she is still waiting.
qs.exp: Continuous with for → still going on.

qs.q: We ___ (wait) for the documents since Monday.
a: have been waiting
've been waiting

qs.q: How long has she ___ (work) in this department?
a: been working

qs.q: It ___ (rain) all morning. The roads are wet.
a: has been raining
's been raining

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i have been working here for six years

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: how long have you been studying english
qs.exp: Question: how long have you been + -ing.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: they have been testing the system since june

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I am working here since 2018.”
a: I have been working here since 2018.
I've been working here since 2018.
I have worked here since 2018.
I've worked here since 2018.
qs.exp: since → Present Perfect, not Present Continuous.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “How long are you waiting?”
a: How long have you been waiting?
qs.exp: How long + until now → have you been waiting.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I have been knowing her since school.”
a: I have known her since school.
I've known her since school.

qs.q: Я изучаю английский уже два года.
a: I have been learning English for two years.
I've been learning English for two years.
I have been studying English for two years.
I've been studying English for two years.
How long have you been working here?
How long have you worked here?
qs.ru: How long have you been working.

a: We have been waiting since nine a.m.
We've been waiting since nine a.m.
We have been waiting since 9 a.m.
We've been waiting since 9 a.m.
We have been waiting since nine o'clock.
We've been waiting since nine in the morning.
